summary_zh: 前文称 DeepSeek 完成首轮外部融资，金额和估值都很高；收录帖进一步列出 Liang、腾讯、宁德时代、主品牌、网易等出资方，将话题转向相关品牌/公司的投资参与，而非商品、价格或配送体验。片段中无后续回应，可用于判断这是融资传闻扩散，情绪偏中性，需关注信源“据报道”。

posts.text: DeepSeek closed its first-ever external funding round at roughly $7.4 billion, with a post-money valuation reported between $52 billion and $59 billion.
posts.original_text: DeepSeek closed its first-ever external funding round at roughly $7.4 billion, with a post-money valuation reported between $52 billion and $59 billion.
posts.translation_zh: DeepSeek 完成了有史以来首轮外部融资，融资额约为 74 亿美元，据报道投后估值在 520 亿至 590 亿美元之间。

posts.text: Liang himself committed the largest single cheque (reported around 20 billion yuan). Tencent and CATL were the biggest external commercial names. https://t.co/DQ7VwGORFJ, NetEase, and others also participated.
